notes: This registry is the sole authorization source for official-market eligibility.
Hardcoded source-code PASS labels are forbidden.

DEPLOYMENT PARITY RULE: statistical validation is necessary but NOT sufficient. A market may only be official_eligible if the deployed runtime ships the same model that produced the reported calibration. Where validation is good but the runtime still carries a different implementation, status is VALIDATED_NOT_DEPLOYED and official_eligible remains false.
ARTIFACT-IS-NOT-ENGINE RULE: the presence of a joblib/model artifact does not constitute a validated executable engine. No validated engine = no official eligibility, regardless of what files ship.
SE figures are worst-threshold out-of-sample calibration gaps measured on 2021-2024 with train/holdout separation, unless otherwise noted.
Walk-forward calibration evidence is not accepted for official release unless the same calibration state/update mechanism is deployed live.

v1.6: RBI and Runs promoted from VALIDATED_NOT_DEPLOYED after clean-process artifact round-trip acceptance. Serialized artifacts were reloaded in a fresh process, scored against an independently rebuilt untouched window, and reproduced the reported calibration exactly with matching validation hashes.

status_vocabulary.PASS_CAUTION: validated and deployed with a documented caveat; official eligible with grading penalty
status_vocabulary.PASS_GATED: validated and deployed but only within a restricted scope; official eligible inside that scope only
status_vocabulary.PASS_BETA: deployed frozen beta anchor; official eligible with beta penalty
status_vocabulary.VALIDATED_NOT_DEPLOYED: validation evidence is good, but the runtime does not yet ship the model that produced it; NOT official eligible
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED_UNBUILT: no engine exists; not official eligible
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED_DEPLOYMENT_PARITY: deployed architecture cannot be shown to match the validated one; not official eligible

moneyline.reason: Frozen beta anchor is executable; beta penalty remains in grading.

run line.reason: RL calibrated cleanly (0.09pp / 0.12 SE) only under the MC_V2 split architecture, which carried a measured ML calibration cost (Brier 0.24599 -> 0.25010). Cannot show the deployed runtime uses that exact configuration. Unchanged from prior registry.

total.reason: Persistent borderline totals gap (1.40pp / ~1.87 SE on full 4,406-game holdout) was measured but deliberately left uncorrected; holdout is spent. Requires fresh-sample reconfirmation before official release. Unchanged from prior registry.

team total.reason: Threshold-dependent. 5.5+ usable; 4.5 caution; 2.5/3.5 blocked (2.43pp/3.57 SE and 2.05pp/2.74 SE respectively). Execution policy must enforce the line restriction.

f5 moneyline.reason: Independent F5 artifact validated on untouched 2024 holdout.

f5 run line.reason: Independent F5 margin distribution validated on common thresholds.

f5 total.reason: Independent F5 total distribution validated on common thresholds.

f5 team total.reason: General F5 team-total path allowed; home F5 TT 0.5 remains caution/block by execution policy (3.95 SE).

nrfi/yrfi.reason: Direct first-inning model. Fixed by replacing share-scaling with direct inning-1 fitting: 4.40 SE -> 1.60 SE. Home-half calibration borderline at 2.07 SE; extra caution on home-side derivatives.

pitcher strikeouts.reason: Starts-only workload plus opponent-lineup K adjustment (fitted coefficient 1.02) are required and wired. Worst threshold 2.12 SE. Simulated variance ~18% short of actual; extra caution on extreme tail lines.

pitcher outs.reason: Strongest pitcher market. Worst calibration 0.94 SE. Mild caution on deep-tail alt lines (variance ~13% compressed, short-start tail slightly overweighted).

pitcher hits.reason: Historically validated; worst calibration 1.73 SE. Variance matches actual closely (5.190 vs 5.179).

pitcher walks.reason: Fixed via era-drift diagnosis: rolling 45-day league recalibration plus shrinkage selected on 2023 development, scored clean on 2024. 7.16 SE -> 2.18 SE. Requires the rolling recalibration to be live; frozen-parameter deployment is not equivalent.
pitcher walks.deployment_requirement: rolling league recalibration must be active in production

pitcher earned runs.reason: Best achieved 3.25 SE after four distinct approaches (Poisson, negative binomial, blowup/volatility features, monthly walk-forward refit, isotonic calibration). Consistently under-predicts blowup starts. ER/out swings erratically year to year with no fittable trend.

hits.reason: Fixed by shared game-level effect (lognormal sigma=0.20 fit on train only): 7.56 SE -> 2.63 SE. Beta-binomial was tested and ruled out (fitted rho ~0.0014); the real cause was game-level shared conditions, not per-batter overdispersion.
hits.deployment_requirement: shared game-effect sampling (sigma=0.20) must be active

total bases.reason: Fixed by the same shared game effect, using the sigma fitted on hits WITHOUT refitting on TB: 5.32 SE -> 1.60 SE. Cross-market transfer is stronger evidence than a per-market tuned constant.
total bases.deployment_requirement: shared game-effect sampling (sigma=0.20) must be active

hr.reason: Retrosheet-native multiplicative rare-event model (batter HR rate exponent 1.1, pitcher 0.4, park 0.9, platoon 1.05). 0.30pp gap / 2.45 SE with reliability tracking across six probability buckets. Mild caution in the 11-14% band (1.08pp under-prediction). Statcast/Chadwick layer is an enhancement, not a rescue.

rbi.reason: Direct-threshold logistic models with walk-forward refit. Clean-process artifact round-trip reproduced 1.28 SE exactly (0.5: 0.21pp/1.28 SE, 1.5: 0.08pp/0.70 SE, 2.5: 0.06pp/0.87 SE, n=79,667). Journey: 46.88 SE standalone-rate -> 9.30 SE joint-sim -> 1.28 SE direct-threshold.
rbi.deployment_requirement: runtime MUST load sportsedge_rbi_direct_v1.joblib with the recorded artifact_hash; any substitution reverts this market to VALIDATED_NOT_DEPLOYED

runs.reason: Direct-threshold logistic models with walk-forward refit. Clean-process artifact round-trip reproduced 2.34 SE exactly (0.5: 0.40pp/2.34 SE, 1.5: 0.02pp/0.25 SE, 2.5: 0.03pp/0.77 SE, n=79,667). Worst threshold is the 0.5 line; caution applied there. Journey: 8.00 SE standalone -> 9.11 SE joint-sim -> 2.34 SE direct-threshold.
runs.deployment_requirement: runtime MUST load sportsedge_runs_direct_v1.joblib with the recorded artifact_hash; any substitution reverts this market to VALIDATED_NOT_DEPLOYED

sb.reason: No engine was ever built and no validation was ever run. A joblib artifact shipping in the package does not constitute a validated executable engine. Authorization removed.

sgp.reason: Same-path Monte Carlo joint pricing validated at 2.79 SE worst-case across 7 combination types including a 3-leg case. Naive independence underprices correlated combos by 19-42% (1R_3RBI: 7.21 SE naive vs 2.60 SE shared-path), confirming shared paths are required rather than cosmetic.

scope.leg_requirement: every leg must itself be official_eligible AND share one simulation path id
